Task Name: Approve project charter and measurable goal
Description: Confirm scope, sponsor, roles, success criteria, and decision authority. Complete when sponsor records approval and goal metrics are accepted.
Acceptance Criteria: Charter and goal approved; scope and decision rights documented.

Description: List operations, security, privacy, legal, accessibility, IT, and passenger-experience stakeholders; identify accountable reviewers.
Acceptance Criteria: Stakeholder register includes role, responsibility, and review point.

Description: Map the current passenger journey and identify pain points, exception paths, and operational constraints without including personal passenger data.
Acceptance Criteria: Current-state map reviewed by operations and customer-experience leads.

Description: Document data minimization, access, retention, deletion, incident escalation, and assessment requirements with qualified reviewers.
Acceptance Criteria: Requirements are documented and privacy review outcome is recorded.

Task Name: Define accessibility and human fallback requirements
Description: Specify accessible alternatives, assisted processing, exception handling, and a human-supported fallback path.
Acceptance Criteria: Fallback and accessibility requirements are reviewed and dispositioned.

Description: Capture workflow, service, reliability, integration, support, and audit requirements at a non-sensitive planning level.
Acceptance Criteria: Requirements are traceable to owners and acceptance criteria.

Task Name: Sign off on requirements and safeguards
Description: Obtain documented cross-functional sign-off on requirements, privacy safeguards, accessibility, and fallback design.
Acceptance Criteria: Required reviewers have recorded approval or a documented exception.

Task Name: Create pilot test plan and acceptance criteria
Description: Define representative test scenarios, expected results, owners, defect severity, and evidence capture method.
Acceptance Criteria: Test plan covers normal, exception, accessibility, fallback, and failure scenarios.

Description: Conduct authorized security and privacy reviews; track findings and owners without putting sensitive technical details in general tasks.
Acceptance Criteria: Findings have a disposition, owner, and closure evidence.

Description: Run approved accessibility and fallback checks with appropriate reviewers and representative participants.
Acceptance Criteria: All identified issues are resolved or formally accepted by authorized owners.

Description: Assign and resolve critical issues; document accepted residual risk through approved governance.
Acceptance Criteria: No unresolved critical finding remains without explicit authorized disposition.

Description: Review test results, privacy/security sign-offs, accessibility, fallback, staffing, support, and communications; record go/no-go.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision and rationale are recorded; no launch occurs without required approval.

Task Name: Prepare pilot support and escalation plan
Description: Define support hours, ownership, issue triage, escalation contacts, rollback/fallback decision process, and communications.
Acceptance Criteria: Support roles and escalation path are confirmed.

Task Name: Run approved pilot and capture outcomes
Description: Only after go decision, conduct the authorized limited pilot and record aggregate outcomes and exceptions without storing biometric records in Asana.
Acceptance Criteria: Pilot report contains aggregate measures, issues, feedback, and limitations.

Task Name: Evaluate outcomes and recommend next step
Description: Compare pilot results with approved baseline and targets; recommend stop, revise, extend, or scale with evidence.
Acceptance Criteria: Sponsor receives a recommendation and documented decision.

Task Name: Publish lessons learned and close project
Description: Summarize outcomes, open risks, decisions, owners, and reusable improvements; archive according to policy.
Acceptance Criteria: Lessons learned are published and follow-up actions have owners.
